summary: Read two binary search trees. Either tree may be empty. Collect every integer stored on a node of either tree, arrange those integers from smallest to largest, and write the list. Each tree has at most 5000 nodes, and each node value lies between -10^5 and 10^5. If the same integer occurs more than once, repeat it in the list once for every occurrence instead of collapsing the copies. An empty tree contributes no integers.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
